duplicates.candidate_evaluation: deduplicate by the deterministic candidate evaluation id; audit records are idempotent
duplicates.execution_attempt: expected and permitted; a repeated attempt must not create a duplicate scientific sample
duplicates.scientific_row: reject: two rows with one residual_scientific_row_id are a duplicate scientific sample

principle: SCIENTIFIC IDENTITY IS INDEPENDENT OF EXECUTION CHUNKING

retry.outcome_rule: canonically identical output, or provenance validation failure; never a second scientific sample
retry.replay_rule: an infrastructure retry replays the same scientific row identity, the same nine candidate evaluation identities, the same snapshot and the same matched streams, in the same candidate order
